entities.summary: The Affiliated Zhongli Senior High School of National Central University is a public high school, which is located in Zhongli District, Taoyuan City, Taiwan. National Zhongli Senior High School was previously a Japanese Temple built in October 1939. After KMT migrated to Taiwan, the temple was abolished and became a local senior high school.
